name: northwind-m2-findings-sarif

brief.objective: Produce a validated findings register with SARIF 2.1.0 output for Northwind Ledger.

notes: Each finding needs CWE/OWASP class, a CVSS score, a source->sink exploit scenario and a code-level fix. SARIF must validate, every location must resolve to a real file:line with a matching snippet, and every claimed secret must reproduce from a fresh scan. Static evidence only; no live exploitation.
